subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: Should this Gateway and session-state change require a successful live two-peer Reef discovery-and-turn transcript before merge, or receive an explicit proof override based on the exact-head automated evidence?
rationale: The automated coverage is strong, but the PR changes externally observable discovery and lazy durable-session binding, while its own live proof is deferred until after landing.

options.title: Require live Reef proof
options.body: Capture a redacted exact-head two-peer run showing first-contact listing, lazy session creation, delivery, and correlated reply before merge.

options.title: Explicit proof override
options.body: A maintainer may deliberately accept the focused Testbox, protocol, build, and migration evidence without pre-merge live deployment proof.

recommendation.title: Require live Reef proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted exact-head two-peer run showing first-contact listing, lazy session creation, delivery, and correlated reply before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and recently maintained the external-conversation architecture and Reef integration underlying the decision.
